title: Codex leftover is readable as five-hour and weekly windows
description:
As a dispatcher I want Codex 5h and weekly leftover so Codex spare capacity is a first-class pool.

Wrap cclimits, CodexBar, or app-server rateLimits. Prefer file creds in ~/.codex/auth.json.

Feature: Codex leftover
  Scenario: weekly window is present
    Given a working Codex leftover probe
    When Spotticus asks for Codex leftover
    Then it reports used percent and resets_at for the weekly window
    And it fails closed if the probe is unreadable
